referenceTool.name: reference_read
referenceTool.description: Reads Tsugumi's bundled references (read only): demos/ (working example projects), sdk/python/tsugumi/__init__.py (the Python Card SDK) and card-guide.md. A folder lists its entries.

delegateTool.name: delegate
delegateTool.description: Hands independent parts of the work to helper Agents that work at the same time in this project, one per task, with the same tools; returns each helper's report once all have finished. Each task owns the root-level Cards it lists: its helper changes only their definitions (never tsugumi.json, the layout or another Card), and a Card belongs to one task only.

name.description: a short name for the helper, e.g. its Card's id

cards.description: ids of the root-level Cards this helper owns

instruction.description: what to do, how to check it and what to report

helper.outside: The helper {name} may change only its own Cards ({cards}); this save also changes {what}. Nothing was saved: change only your Cards.
helper.invalid: delegate needs 2 to 8 tasks, each with a name, an instruction and root-level Cards of this project that no other task lists: {why}

permissionDeclined: The user did not approve what this save gives Cards: {permissions}. Nothing was saved. Do not retry it; tell the user what the Card needs and why, and leave the setting to them.
